title: [GAP-10] No conformance classes beyond the relay, and no must-understand extensions
description: Review finding GAP-10: No conformance classes beyond the relay, and no must-understand extensions (lens GAP). Location: spec/10-relays.md:520-564; spec/07-compliance.md:54, 165, 281-300; spec/13-encoding.md:102; spec/01-overview.md:23. Fix: The missing conformance classes are confirmed: "conformant client" is used at 07:54, 07:165 and 05:461 but never defined. The must-understand half is partly covered already. Documents with an unsupported `schemaVersion` MUST be rejected (01:23, 13:112), and 14-jmap:49 already makes an unsupported consistency model read-only. So a new enforcement-relevant field can be forced on old clients by bumping `schemaVersion`. A simpler fix than a new `requiredExtensions` array is a rule that any Space-state field which a CO enforcement point (ARCHITECTURE §6.3) depends on requires a `schemaVersion` bump. Either works. Prefer the existing mechanism unless finer granularity is wanted. Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
